proposal: Capture a bounded worker pool and workspace for one direct Generate/GenerateChat invocation; retain token-at-a-time prompt/decode arithmetic and sampling order; borrow logits only until the next forward call. Small geometries that keep every possible kernel below the existing inline threshold use no background workers.
micro: Native 256-dim,704-hidden,1-layer,4-head/2-KV model with 512 context; 33-token prompt, 8/128 output tokens; both implementation orders, 3 samples,4 threads. Fixed-step tokenizer only in benchmark so EOS does not shorten workload. Includes worker startup/teardown and sampling.
limits: No real-7B speed claim for this separate change. The first attention PR supplies core model evidence; direct CLI chat functionality is checked separately. No shared mutable executor on Model.
